tool.name: Beacon2 Cohorts
tool.description: retrieve cohorts from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query entity --entity cohort @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.lookup.mode) == "by_id" --entity-id '$connection.lookup.entity_id' #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query entity --entity cohort --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' #if str($connection.mongo_fields.cohortDataTypes) --field 'cohortDataTypes.label=$connection.mongo_fields.cohortDataTypes' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.cohortDesign) --field 'cohortDesign.label=$connection.mongo_fields.cohortDesign' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.cohortSize) --field 'cohortSize=$connection.mongo_fields.cohortSize' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.cohortType) --field 'cohortType=$connection.mongo_fields.cohortType' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.identification) --entity-id '$connection.mongo_fields.identification' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.genders) --field 'inclusionCriteria.genders.label=$connection.mongo_fields.genders' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.name) --field 'name=$connection.mongo_fields.name' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: entity_id
param.label: Identifier
param.help: As used by that beacon. Identifiers are local to each beacon.

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Fields to match (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: cohortDataTypes
param.label: COHORTDATA TYPES
param.help: The type of data chorort, e.g. clinical history Matched exactly against cohortDataTypes.label.

param.name: cohortDesign
param.label: COHORTDESIGN
param.help: A plan specification comprised of protocols that are executed as part of an investigation, e.g. longitudinal study design Matched exactly against cohortDesign.label.

param.name: cohortSize
param.label: COHORT SIZE
param.help: Count of unique Individuals in cohort Matched exactly against cohortSize.

param.name: cohortType
param.label: COHORT TYPE
param.help: Cohort type by its definition, e.g. study-defined Matched exactly against cohortType.

param.name: name
param.label: NAME
param.help: Name of the cohort Matched exactly against name.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Retrieves cohort records from the beacons you select, or from a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
